title: Random Supply Box
description: Random Supply Box – Indestructible loot boxes spawn every 2 minutes with rarity‑weighted random items. Vanish after 10 minutes.
body:
# Random Supply Box

**Random Supply Box** is a lightweight Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that automatically spawns indestructible loot boxes across your world – every 2 minutes, at a completely random location.

## ✨ Features

- **Automatic spawning** – A new supply box appears every 2 minutes (2400 ticks).  
- **Truly random positions** – X/Z range: ±29,999,983, Y range: -67 to 100. The box replaces any existing block.  
- **Random loot, weighted by rarity** – Each box contains 5–20 stacks of random items. Common items are more frequent; epic items are rare.  
- **No creative‑only items** – Bedrock, command blocks, barriers, structure blocks, etc. are excluded.  
- **Indestructible** – Cannot be broken by players (even in Creative mode).  
- **Auto‑disappears** – Each box vanishes after 10 minutes (12000 ticks).  
- **Vanilla chest texture** – Uses the classic chest appearance (you need to copy the texture once – see Installation).  

## 📥 Installation

1. Install **Fabric Loader** (0.15.0 or later) and **Fabric API** for Minecraft 1.21.1.  
2. Download this mod’s `.jar` file and place it in your `mods` folder.  
3. **Texture fix**: To see the chest texture, copy  
   `assets/minecraft/textures/entity/chest/normal.png` from a default Minecraft resource pack to  
   `assets/randomsupplybox/textures/block/supply_box.png` inside the mod JAR (or into a separate resource pack).  
   *If you skip this, the box will show a purple/black missing texture.*  
4. Launch the game – the mod works on both singleplayer and servers.

## ⚙️ Technical details

| Setting            | Value                        |
|--------------------|------------------------------|
| Spawn interval     | 2 minutes (2400 ticks)       |
| Box lifespan       | 10 minutes (12000 ticks)     |
| X/Z range          | -29,999,983 to 29,999,983    |
| Y range            | -67 to 100                   |
| Inventory size     | 27 slots (3 rows)            |
| Number of stacks   | 5–20 per box                 |
| Rarity weights     | Common=100, Uncommon=30, Rare=8, Epic=2 |

## 🔧 Compatibility

- Works with any mod that doesn’t break vanilla item registry or world generation.  
- Compatible with performance mods (Sodium, Lithium, etc.).
